description: ECOWAS region (West Africa) - Hydropower potential and River network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower, Renewable energy", published or maintained by ECREEE (ECREEE). This dataset shows the river network for West Africa and the estimated hydropower potential as well as several other interesting attributes. After detailed calculation, the attribute values were rounded to a reasonable accuracy. This dataset is not intended for local studies but only for regional comparison. Coverage: 14 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 2 files in RAR, GPKG. The portal files it under Hydropower, Renewable energy, Resource assessments. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
